55: /**

58:  * or 500ms elapse with no data, mark unavailable. If data arrives, mark

182: /**
183:  * Process a single accelerometer sample from hardware.
184:  * 1. Compute magnitude.
185:  * 2. Update gravity estimate via EMA.
186:  * 3. Compute linear acceleration (magnitude minus gravity).
187:  * 4. Run peak detection state machine.
188:  * 5. On confirmed peak, emit one punch event.
189:  *
190:  * @param {Object} res — { x, y, z } from system.sensor
191:  */
192: function _onAccelerometerData(res) {
193:   if (!_sensorAvailable || !_punchCallback) { return; }
194: 
195:   var x = res.x || 0;
196:   var y = res.y || 0;
197:   var z = res.z || 0;
198:   var mag = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);
199:   var now = Date.now();
200: 
201:   // 1. Update gravity estimate (EMA)
202:   if (_gravity === 0) {
203:     _gravity = mag;
204:   } else {
205:     _gravity = GRAVITY_EMA_ALPHA * _gravity + (1 - GRAVITY_EMA_ALPHA) * mag;
206:   }
207: 
208:   // 2. Linear acceleration = total minus gravity
209:   var linear = Math.abs(mag - _gravity);
210: 
211:   // 3. Peak detection state machine
212:   switch (_peakState) {
213:     case PEAK_IDLE:
214:       if (linear > PUNCH_LINEAR_THRESHOLD) {
215:         _peakState = PEAK_RISING;
216:         _peakValue = linear;
217:         _peakStartTime = now;
218:       }
219:       break;

224:       } else {
225:         _peakState = PEAK_HOLDING;
226:         _peakStartTime = now;
227:       }

233:         _peakValue = linear;
234:       } else if (now - _peakStartTime >= PEAK_HOLDBACK_MS) {
235:         if (now - _lastPunchTime >= COOLDOWN_MS) {
236:           _lastPunchTime = now;
237:           var confidence = Math.min(0.95, 0.5 + _peakValue * CONFIDENCE_SCALE);

239:           _punchCallback({

242:             confidence: Math.round(confidence * 100) / 100,

245:         }

247:         _peakStartTime = now;
248:       }

255:       }
